description: Fiber is a Go web framework with a compact request context. These lessons use its stable v2 API. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.
versionNote: Examples target Fiber v2, specifically v2.52, and Go 1.22 or later. Fiber v3 has different APIs.
whatYouWillLearn: Read a query string with Fiber
Point to another route with Fiber
learningObjectives: Parse an integer input with Fiber
Set a reply header with Fiber
